title: Support The Show
html:
Celebrate with Us!

We understand that with the financial instability in the world today, the thought of supporting independent media for $500 can seem daunting. We want to make this celebration accessible to as many producers as possible!
SO, for those who want to take part in the ep 500 celebrations, become a knight or dame, and receive the challenge coin, but cannot make a one-time $500 commitment.
MAKE THE EP 500 COMMEMORATIVE PLEDGE! Any producer who pledges and produces the show for $10 per episode starting on episode 500 and ending on episode 555 will be inducted into the Canary Cry Roundtable of Knights and Dames AND receive the challenge coin!
(By Signing up, you will automatically produce the show for $10 every episode, set it and forget it and be rewarded on episode 555!)

I’m In! let’s do it!
